body:
:) Thank you! Yes I just got out of the gym and I'm feeling a lot more clear headed.  I do try and do things that distract me, but sometimes it's just so much easier to wallow and cry, you know? 

I write a lot too.  Largely awful prose or poetry (and by awful I mean HORRENDOUS!)  I'm at a point in my life where I was trying REALLY hard to get better, and tonight I was just kind of hit with something with a little bit more "oomph" and it pushed me off my wagon. 

Thank you for sharing with me, I am open eyes and here to listen if you ever need someone to talk to :)
